title: Judge sentences Feeding Our Future fraudsters who faked running child nutrition site
notes: USAO-MN's own press release (src-usao-mn-2026-08-27-fof-three-sentences) explicitly does not state restitution amounts for Ahmed or Ghedi. This article supplies specific restitution figures not in the primary release; treat as secondary until a sentencing judgment or docket entry is captured.
supports: Abdihakim Ahmed was ordered to pay restitution of $2,242,590.
Ahmed Ghedi was ordered to pay restitution of $2,862,451.

Ghedi and Ahmed diverted approximately $7.3 million in federal Child Nutrition Program funds through a fraudulent meal site, including funds used for a car, property, and kickbacks to a Feeding Our Future employee.
Ghedi's site claimed to receive $7.2 million total from the Federal Child Nutrition Program through fraudulent claims.
does_not_support: A case number, docket citation, or judge's name; not stated in this article.
Any restitution figure for Ahmed Sharif Omar-Hashim, the third defendant sentenced in the same USAO release.
